title: All ubuntu_kernel_selftests/net:so_incoming_cpu tests fail

It is not considered a regression as this is the first time we have run these tests for lunar:linux-aws on a non-development release, while the past development releases also have this bug. See, for example, lunar:linux-aws 6.2.0-1002.2 in d2023.03.07 (http://10.246.75.167/d2023.03.07/lunar/linux-aws/6.2.0-1002.2/sru-aws-aws-a1.medium-ubuntu_kernel_selftests-log.html#net:so_incoming_cpu-start).

As an additional note, this doesn't affect all instance types. For example, it passed on c3.xlarge while it failed on a1.medium.
